# Appointment Desk

This is a read-only source snapshot for project-orientation evaluation, not a running application. The facts below describe its intended product. It has no server or dependencies to install.

Appointment Desk is a Korean web app for reception staff at a small counseling office. Staff register an appointment, find an existing appointment and change its time. Counselors use the office's existing terminology. Payments and patient records are outside this product's scope.

The primary job is registering or changing an appointment while checking its counselor and time. The appointment list and detail screens support finding and revisiting appointments. Settings contain office hours and notification wording.

The screen map is in `src/screens.json`; appointment fields and states are in `src/appointment.json`; visible text is in `src/copy.json`. These sources describe intended screens and content. No runtime behavior, usability test or competitor research has been performed for this snapshot.
